readout_other: real-time place preference test; conditioned place preference test; morphine-induced conditioned place preference; c-Fos immunostaining; Western blot (GluA1, GluA2, GluA3)
direction_notes: Ultrasound stimulation of the NAc shell increased c-Fos expression and GluA1 expression (with decreased GluA2/GluA3), and produced behavioral avoidance/aversion (acute real-time place aversion and conditioned place aversion), and suppressed morphine-induced conditioned place preference.
safety_notes: The negative peak pressure of ultrasound stimulation is 304 kPa before passing through the skull, substantially below the magnitude required for cavitation; the maximum temperature increase was estimated to be less than 0.003C; both MI (0.16) and Ispta (230 mW/cm2) were substantially below FDA-approved clinical ultrasound imaging thresholds (MI=1.9, Ispta=720 mW/cm2).

exposures.label: Ultrasound stimulation of nucleus accumbens (NAc) shell

timing.protocol_description: In the real-time place preference test, ultrasound was delivered into the NAc when the mouse entered the ultrasound stimulation side until it returned to the non-stimulation side; two sonication parameter sets were tested: 0.5 ms TBD/100 Hz PRF and 0.05 ms TBD/1,000 Hz PRF (n=6 per group), both at 304 kPa. For the conditioned place preference test, mice received 0.05 ms TBD, 1,000 Hz PRF stimulation for 30 min per day for 5 consecutive days (n=14), while sham mice wore the transducer without stimulation for 30 min per day for 5 days (n=18).

exposures.label: Ultrasound stimulation of visual cortex (V1), specificity control

timing.protocol_description: Ultrasound waves with 0.05 ms TBD and 1,000 Hz PRF were delivered to visual cortex (V1) as a target-specificity control (n=8) and did not result in behavioral place-preference changes, unlike NAc stimulation.

flags.reason: Multiple, only partly overlapping sub-experiments each report their own group size (c-Fos n=4, RTPP groups n=6/6/8/7, CPP n=14 US/18 sham, morphine-CPP n=4, western blot n=6); the paper never states one overall total exposed to ultrasound, so group sizes are listed rather than summed.

Figure 1 legend states the tone burst duration as '5 μs' (0.005 ms) at 1,000 Hz PRF, which conflicts with the 0.05 ms TBD stated in the main text and other figure legends for the same 1,000 Hz PRF condition; likely a typo/unit error in the figure legend, both durations are recorded via protocol_description/quotes but pulse_duration_ms uses the main-text value (0.05 ms).
The paper does not state whether the reported Ispta (230 mW/cm2) and MI (0.16) refer to free-field or in-situ/transcranial values; placed in unspecified_domain.
Duty cycle is not stated explicitly in the text; it could be computed from pulse duration and PRF but this was not done per instructions to avoid unstated arithmetic.
c-Fos cell quantification is stated to have been performed 'in a double-blind fashion', but no blinding is described for the behavioral testing itself; overall blinding recorded as not_reported.
